fields.description: The workbook (BOQs) this ground-truth label belongs to. Denormalized (mirrors BoQ Row Category) so the snapshot is filterable + joinable by BoQ.
fields.label: BoQ

fields.description: The committed sheet name, stored VERBATIM (#152 -- never stripped/trimmed). Durable Excel-address identity component, matching BoQ Row Category.sheet_name.
fields.label: Sheet Name

fields.description: The source Excel row number this label annotates (= BoQ Row Category.excel_row = BOQ Nodes.source_row_number). Durable identity component; a label is PER-ROW.
fields.label: Excel Row

fields.description: The engine/discipline this label belongs to. IN the identity tuple (mirrors BoQ Row Category) so a second engine's label for the SAME Excel address coexists.
fields.label: Discipline

fields.description: The committed-tier commit_version of the sheet current AT snapshot time. Anchors the label to a specific committed version.
fields.label: Committed Version

fields.description: The frozen-vocabulary category id (categories_<discipline>.json) captured as ground truth at snapshot time. Non-empty (validated in the controller).
fields.label: Label Category Id

fields.description: One shared id per freeze/load event -- every row banked in the same load carries the same snapshot_batch. Snapshots are PERMANENT (never deleted); a new event mints a new batch.
fields.label: Snapshot Batch

fields.description: How this snapshot was banked: a bulk load of the team's Excel labels, or a Freeze event in product.
fields.label: Source
fields.options:
Bulk-loaded ground truth
Frozen in product

fields.description: When this snapshot row was banked. Set by the write path.
fields.label: Snapshot At

fields.description: Who/what banked this snapshot (e.g. 'ground-truth-bulk' for the Excel load, or a user for an in-product freeze).
fields.label: Snapshot By
